text:
Noah (AE): Need a quick deliverable for a prospect: full CAIQ export + a short, plain-language shared-responsibility blurb focused on KMS behavior (rotation, revocation, residency) for their 2-week POC. They also want a proof-of-concept plan that demonstrates key revocation (i.e., they revoke a grant and we show calls fail). Finally, a cost comparison: Dedicated POC vs hosted-with-CMK. Can someone own end-to-end?

Gabriela (Sec): I can own the CAIQ + annotated exceptions and the SR blurb. Quick clarifying q's: do they require EU-only keys (no replication), or EU-primary with failover to US allowed? Also, do they want a live revocation demo during the POC (requires an admin on their side to revoke grants)?

Owen (SE): From the kickoff email: they want EU-primary key residency, failover allowed only if the key material is replicated in their KMS; they also explicitly want a revocation demonstration. Traffic estimate ~5 rps, uses ~8k token generations for a few long prompts. They prefer Dedicated for audit reasons, but cost sensitivity may push them to hosted-with-CMK.

audit-bot: CAIQ template (internal): https://redwood.internal/security/controls/ca iq-export-2026 (latest)

Gabriela (Sec): Plan: I'll export the CAIQ and mark controls with simple tags and short rationales. Example entries I'll include:
- CCM-ENC-01 (transit): GREEN — TLS enforced by default; option for mTLS on Dedicated.
- CCM-ENC-04 (customer-managed keys): AMBER — we support CMK with AWS/GCP KMS; require grant/IAM setup and cannot enforce KMS geo-placement.
- CCM-OPS-03 (host access): AMBER on hosted, GREEN on Dedicated/Private with contract controls.
I'll also write a one-paragraph shared-responsibility blurb for the customer-facing packet. ETA EOD.

Owen (SE): For the revocation demo runbook, propose these steps in the one-pager runbook: VPC peering (if Dedicated), customer grants KMS decrypt/encrypt to Redwood principal, baseline smoke test, customer revokes grant, run smoke test again expecting 403/DecryptError. Add an example IAM policy and smoke test curl.

Owen (SE): Example IAM policy snippet (to include in runbook):
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::REDWOOD_ACCOUNT:role/redwood-kms-access"},
      "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456789012:key/EXAMPLE-KEY"
    }
  ]
}
```

Owen (SE): Smoke test (example):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDFWD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"test prompt","max_tokens":2000}'
```
Expect success before revocation and a clear decrypt/error after revocation. We'll capture timestamps and KMS audit logs for evidence.

Claire (Pricing): Cost sketch (rough estimates):
- Dedicated POC: 1x A10G-equivalent pool reserved for 14 days + private VPC peering setup + storage + egress + 2 engineer-hours/day support for revocation demo = USD 17,200 (includes 48-72h setup labor).
- Hosted-with-CMK: shared-hosted pool + CMK integration + logs export = USD 2,700 for 14 days.
- Optional: Live revocation demo with engineering on-call support (during customer test window) = one-time ops fee USD 2,000.
I'll create an itemized spreadsheet (GPU hours, storage GB, egress GB, ops hours, setup fee) and drop link here. ETA 3pm PT.

Gabriela (Sec): I'll call out any CAIQ controls that require contract language (e.g., host access limitations, evidence delivery) and mark them RED/AMBER/GREEN with short remediation/notes. Also will include wording about "we do not persist plaintext key material" when CMK is used and how revocation blocks decryption until grants restored.

Noah (AE): Perfect. Owners: Gabriela = CAIQ + SR blurb; Owen = runbook + revocation test steps + example IAM; Claire = itemized quote. Please attach drafts here. I'll tell the customer 48-72h depending on whether they want the live revocation demo. :thumbsup:

Gabriela (Sec): Exported CAIQ + annotated CSV will be posted by EOD. I'll flag key residency as AMBER and host-access exceptions for hosted plans.

Owen (SE): Runbook draft with commands, IAM JSON, and a sample revocation checklist by 2pm.

Claire (Pricing): Spreadsheet link will be posted at 3pm PT.

Noah (AE): Thanks team — will notify customer of the timeline and hold off on scheduling the revocation demo until we have the runbook.
